text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Everything is just rumore...
The world sounds like it's cracking apart.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: I feel like I could portray genuine agony right now, but...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"With this pain... I can hardly
even bring myself... to hold the violin."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
The musicisti who expressed their suffering
and pain through music...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I shall face it as well...
As a fellow musicista...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Sounds of Earth seemed to be troubled by a headache...
